Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the point where Shennong decides to help people, add his purpose or determination: “我要找到能治病的植物，帮助大家。”
2. Make the three-month journey more vivid with one travel detail: “他走过了很多高山，也经过了许多小河。”
3. Expand the plant description with a clear visual comparison: “它开着黄色的花，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”

ideas.reason: It gives Shennong a clear goal that fits his wish to help sick people.
It adds a simple, plausible travel detail to his long journey.
It gives the plant a concrete, level-appropriate visual description.
